entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Court No. - 72
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 43672 of 2022
Applicant :- Shani Jaiswal And 2 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Vishveshwar Mani Tripathi

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.
Learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent are present.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with a prayer to quash the charge-sheet No.A325 of 2021 dated 24.09.2021 submitted in Case Crime No.36 of 2021, under Sections 498A,
323, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Campiorganj, District Gorakhpur and entire proceedings of Case No. 18497 of 2022 (State Vs. Shani Jaiswal and others) as well as summoning order dated 19.04.2022, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate-III, Gorakhpur.

entities.text: State Vs. Shani Jaiswal and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: At the time of argument, learned counsel for the applicants submits that a direction be issued to the court concerned regarding bail.

The application is, therefore, disposed of with the direction to the trial court that if the applicants appear before the trial court within 15 days from today and move an application for bail before the trial court, the same shall be decided as soon as possible in view of law laid down in Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, (2021) 10 SCC 773 and Brahm Singh and others Vs. State of U.P. and others, 2016 (95) ACC 950.
